title: Number of Islands
prompt: Given a 2D grid of land and water cells, count how many islands exist.
hints: Each new unvisited land cell starts a traversal.
Mark visited cells so you do not count the same island twice.

title: Clone Graph
prompt: Return a deep copy of a connected undirected graph.
hints: Use a map from old nodes to cloned nodes.
DFS or BFS can both work here.
